environment: local x86-64, PostgreSQL18 Docker, pg_stat_statements track=all/track_planning=on, Redis DB15, disposable *_test database
method: Actual baseline/current ingestion with same deterministic feed shape and fake language output on both sides. PostgreSQL top-level stats reset immediately before each whole ingestion; SQLAlchemy engine/pool events track statements, locks and lifetime. Extra 100k historical articles/origins seeded outside measurement with USER triggers disabled only during fixture loading; internal FKs remain enabled and all triggers restored. Origin relation ANALYZE precedes scaling sample. CPU is complete PostgreSQL container usage including fixed cgroup read probes/background maintenance, not isolated backend CPU.
